# Support

aokit is maintained by one person, so support is best-effort.

- **Bugs:** open an issue with the [bug report form](https://github.com/andryorelabs/aokit/issues/new?template=1-bug_report.yml).
- **Feature ideas:** open an issue with the [feature request form](https://github.com/andryorelabs/aokit/issues/new?template=2-feature_request.yml).
- **Improvements:** open an issue with the [enhancement form](https://github.com/andryorelabs/aokit/issues/new?template=3-enhancement.yml).
- **Documentation:** open an issue with the [documentation form](https://github.com/andryorelabs/aokit/issues/new?template=4-documentation.yml).
- **Security vulnerabilities:** never in a public issue. Follow [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).
- **Contributing:** see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Only the latest release is supported.
